extracted.intended_audience: BBC journalists, editors and content producers worldwide
extracted.subtask_short: BBC editorial guidelines for news content
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-level editorial standards and topic-specific guidance (Editorial Guidelines 2025) that set the BBC's values and rules for producing and publishing content worldwide. Covers 18 named topic areas (e.g., impartiality, accuracy, privacy, politics) and recent updates such as reporting the UK and language guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated Guidance: Reporting the UK
rubrics_metrics.description: A named update to the Editorial Policy concerning how the BBC reports on the UK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a latest update; part of the Editorial Guidelines 2025 updates. (Page notes 'Latest updates' and that all guidance was updated and came into effect from Monday 1 September 2025.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of language
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on language use across BBC content. (Marked 'New guidance' on the page.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identified as new guidance in the 2025 update; applies to all BBC output worldwide under the Editorial Guidelines 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Guidelines 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editorial Guidelines set the BBC's editorial values and standards and apply to all BBC content wherever in the world it is broadcast or published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Umbrella document for the numbered topics below; the page states these guidelines set BBC editorial values and standards and apply globally to BBC content.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1: The BBC's Editorial Standards - essential information
rubrics_metrics.description: Essential information about the BBC's editorial standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the Editorial Guidelines 2025 suite; serves as fundamental, essential guidance for BBC content production and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2: Impartiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on impartiality in BBC content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core Editorial Guideline topic in 2025; applies across BBC output and underpins editorial decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on accuracy in reporting and content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as a principal Editorial Guideline topic; part of standards that all BBC content must meet.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4: Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on identifying and managing conflicts of interest for BBC staff and content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the numbered Editorial Guidelines topics; intended to ensure transparency and protect editorial integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5: Harm and Offence
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on avoiding or responsibly reporting material that may cause harm or offence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the Editorial Guidelines 2025 topics; sets standards for editorial judgment about sensitive content.

rubrics_metrics.name: 6: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on fairness in coverage and treatment of people and issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in the core set of editorial principles to be applied to BBC content worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: 7: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on privacy considerations when producing and publishing content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A named Editorial Guideline topic that governs how personal information and private matters are handled by BBC output.

rubrics_metrics.name: 8: Crime and Anti-social Behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on reporting crime and anti-social behaviour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the topic-specific guidance within the Editorial Guidelines for responsible coverage of crime-related matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: 9: Children and Young People as Contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when and how children and young people may be contributors to BBC content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards to protect minors contributing to or appearing in BBC output; part of the 2025 guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: 10: Politics and Public Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on reporting politics and public policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers standards for political coverage and handling of public policy matters as part of the Editorial Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: 11: Statistics, Polls, Data and Surveys
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the use and presentation of statistics, polls, data and surveys in BBC content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic-specific standards to ensure accurate and responsible use of quantitative information.

rubrics_metrics.name: 12: War, Terror and Extreme Violence, Disaster and Disorder
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on reporting war, terrorism, extreme violence, disasters and disorder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides standards for sensitive, accurate and responsible coverage of extreme events.

rubrics_metrics.name: 13: Use of BBC Content after Publication or Broadcast
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how BBC content may be reused, shared, or repurposed after initial publication or broadcast.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers post-publication use and rights considerations for BBC material.

rubrics_metrics.name: 14: Religious Content
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on covering religious content and beliefs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards for respectful, accurate and balanced treatment of religion within BBC output.

rubrics_metrics.name: 15: Independence from Commercial and other External Interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance to preserve editorial independence from commercial and external influences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of editorial integrity rules to ensure independence in journalism and programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: 16: External Relationships, including Commercial Relationships, and Financing
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on managing external relationships, commercial ties and financing matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how external partnerships and funding interact with editorial decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: 17: Competitions, Votes and Interactivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on running competitions, polls, votes and interactive elements in BBC content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers fairness, transparency and legal/compliance considerations for interactive audience features.

rubrics_metrics.name: 18: The Law
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on legal considerations that affect BBC content, publication and broadcasting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures compliance with relevant legal requirements; part of the core Editorial Guidelines.
